description: This file defines two interfaces for a grain service and its client in the Orleans framework, specifying asynchronous methods related to service state and configuration.

classes.name: ITestGrainService
classes.description: Interface for a grain service providing methods to check service status and retrieve a custom message.

classes.name: ITestGrainServiceClient
classes.description: Interface for a client of the grain service, including methods to invoke the service and an extension method for echo functionality.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a custom 'Hello World' string using a grain reference.

methods.name: HasStarted
methods.description: Checks if the service has started.

methods.name: HasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Checks if the service has started in the background.

methods.name: HasInit
methods.description: Verifies if the service has been initialized.

methods.name: GetServiceConfigProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration property of the service.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Sends a string to be echoed via an extension method on the client.
